verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a client-side iOS terminal/SSH app with no server backend or hosted service component; there is nothing to 'self-host' as it runs locally on user devices and connects out to remote hosts via SSH/Mosh. The 'build it yourself via Xcode' evidence (gh-2, gh-4) is about compiling client source code, not self-hosting a service, so this axis is a category error for this product type.
